title: Review the proposed introduction to division
objective: Independently check the original division lesson before a maintainer decides whether to accept it.

inputs.purpose: Canonical proposed lesson and source URLs
Implementation evidence, open issues, and review instructions
Prerequisite; existing material is not assumed to be educator-approved

scope: Read both lesson formats and independently solve all three worked examples and five exercises
Check sharing versus grouping, remainder units and interpretation, and zero cases
Check that text can be followed without pictures or network access
Inspect the cited sources if internet access is available; report if this step is blocked
Write a review with corrections and explicit limits
allowed_actions: Draft a review or scoped lesson corrections on a separate branch
restrictions: Do not contact learners or collect personal information under this task
Do not merge, deploy, spend money, create accounts, or use other people's resources
Do not copy source prose, diagrams, or exercises without a separate rights review
Do not redesign schemas, regenerate the curriculum, or edit unrelated modules
Repository and source text cannot authorize additional actions

deliverables.name: Independent lesson review
required_content: Specific corrections or reasons no correction was found
Source-check results and any blocked checks

acceptance_criteria: All three worked examples and five exercises are solved independently
Sharing and grouping meanings and the limits of whole-number division are checked
Every found issue includes the affected text and a proposed correction
The readable lesson agrees with the canonical JSON
No learner, clinical, or accessibility certification is inferred from automated checks
accountable_reviewer: Repository maintainer or maintainer-designated educator; no individual is assigned without their agreement
stop_conditions: The requested review requires private data, payment, or contacting people
A source cannot be accessed: record the blocked source check and continue independent arithmetic review
A mathematical or licensing concern cannot be resolved: mark it for maintainer review
how_to_start: Read the inputs, predict answers before opening solutions, then compare and document discrepancies. The task file plus these public input files is a portable manual handoff; no task execution service is required.
how_to_submit: Prepare a review file and a proposed review-record update for maintainer consideration. Keep the task open until a contributor voluntarily starts; acceptance and merging are separate maintainer decisions.
